title: FastAPI traceback returned to a client
description: A Python traceback whose frames run through FastAPI appears in the response body. The trace names the route module, the service method and often the ORM call, so the next request can be shaped for the exact handler that failed.

fp: A page that shows the trace in a screenshot from a tutorial is not reported.
recordDesc: A Python traceback whose frames run through FastAPI in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The trace names the route module, the service method and often the ORM call, so the next request can be shaped for the exact handler that failed.
applicability: Deployments that render a Python traceback whose frames run through FastAPI into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The trace names the route module, the service method and often the ORM call, so the next request can be shaped for the exact handler that failed.
why: The marker exists for the build or administrator and answers a question an attacker would otherwise have to guess.
fix: Run with debug disabled and return a correlation id with a generic message.
Disable debug mode and return a correlation id with a generic message.
verifyT: Request the page again and confirm the response no longer carries a Python traceback whose frames run through FastAPI.
